build_levit_c_model: build a LeViT_c vision transformer model with pretrained weights and fused batch normalization layers
create_levit_c_128: create a LeViT_c_128 model instance with 1000 classes and optional distillation head
create_levit_c_384: create a LeViT_c_384 model instance with pretrained weights for image classification
run_levit_inference: run inference on an image tensor through a pretrained LeViT_c model with fused conv-bn layers
review_attention_subsample: review the AttentionSubsample class that performs strided attention between different resolution feature maps
